# skilldiet

Rules from https://github.com/codegobrrrr9/skilldiet. Copy the folder `skills/skilldiet/scripts/` from the repo to `scripts/skilldiet/`.

1. Run `node scripts/skilldiet/skilldiet.js scan` (or `scan --path <folder>` for any pack) and quote the output. Tokens are estimates (characters / 4): say so.
2. Cost is not quality: a big pack can be worth its listing. A collision is a reason to look, not a verdict.
3. `prune` is a dry run until the user says yes; `--apply` only parks user-owned skills (nothing is deleted, `restore` brings them back).
4. "Never fired" is only as long as the retained Claude Code session logs: say the window printed.
